instructions:
# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.
Offices: ਤਹਿਸੀਲਦਾਰ, ਪਟਵਾਰੀ, ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਪੰਚਾਇਤ, ਡਿਪਟੀ ਕਮਿਸ਼ਨਰ.
Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.
Offices: ତହସିଲଦାର, ବିଡିଓ, ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ, ଜିଲ୍ଲାପାଳ (କଲେକ୍ଟର), ମୋ ସେବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର.

items.t: Give the VHN your Aadhaar, bank passbook, address proof and one PMMVY proof. She enters the application on PICME before delivery, and it is checked by the Sector Health Nurse, the PHC Medical Officer and the Block Medical Officer.
Collect the first nutrition kit at the PHC around the third month. After the fourth month of pregnancy, the first instalment of Rs 6,000 comes into your account.
Go for at least two antenatal check-ups and have the delivery in a government hospital. Get the baby's birth-dose vaccines (BCG, OPV, Hepatitis B) before leaving the hospital.
About four months after delivery, once the baby's vaccines up to 14 weeks are done, the second instalment of Rs 6,000 is paid.
After the measles-rubella (MR) vaccine at 9 months, the last Rs 2,000 is paid. The second nutrition kit is given at the PHC as well.
If a payment is late, ask your VHN first, or call the PICME helpdesk with your RCH number.
044-29510307 / 94890 48910 — PICME helpdesk, Directorate of Public Health / 102 — free ambulance and pregnancy help
Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)

Rs 1,000 every month, paid straight into the bank account, for girls who studied Classes 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government school and have joined college. It is paid until they finish their first degree, diploma or ITI course, on top of any other scholarship. Officially it is the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme, which replaced the old Moovalur Ramamirtham marriage assistance scheme, and since December 2024 girls from government-aided schools are covered too. You apply through your college, which enters your details on the UMIS portal.
Girl who studied Classes 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government school, or in a government-aided school (added in December 2024)
Only the first higher-education course counts; a second degree is not paid
No family income limit, and any number of girls in one family can get it
Bank passbook of an account in the student's own name, linked with Aadhaar (the college helps open a zero-balance account)
Transfer certificate from the school, showing study in a government or government-aided school

Your college's Pudhumai Penn nodal officer, usually in the scholarship section, in the first weeks of the course. Take your Aadhaar, bank passbook, 10th and 12th mark sheets, school transfer certificate and EMIS number; the nodal officer enters and verifies your details on the UMIS portal.
Kavya S
Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Vellaimalai
Name every school if you changed schools. All must be government or government-aided schools.
Government Arts and Science College, Pudhur
The college where you are studying now.
B.Sc Mathematics, first year, 2026
Admission or roll number
From your college ID card or admission slip.
After joining college, meet the Pudhumai Penn nodal officer in the scholarship section during the first weeks.
Hand over your Aadhaar, bank passbook, 10th and 12th mark sheets, school transfer certificate and EMIS number. If you have no bank account, open a zero-balance account through the college.
Your college's Pudhumai Penn nodal officer / District Social Welfare Officer at the Collectorate / 1100 — Tamil Nadu citizen helpline for complaints
Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board Registration (Construction Worker Card)
Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department

Registering with the Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board gives masons, helpers, carpenters, painters, plumbers, electricians and other building workers a registration card that unlocks the board's benefits: education help for children, marriage and maternity money, a monthly pension at 60, accident and death cover, and help to build a house. Registration, renewal and claims are free and done online on the Unorganised Workers Welfare Boards portal, using your mobile number and ration card number. The Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) checks the application, and the permanent registration number comes by SMS.
Pension Rs 1,200 a month at 60; marriage Rs 20,000; maternity Rs 18,000; up to Rs 5 lakh on death at a worksite
Age 18 to 60
Working in one of the 54 construction trades listed by the board, such as mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, bar bender, tile layer, or road and well work
A work certificate in the board's format, signed by an employer, registered contractor, registered trade union office-bearer, the VAO (Revenue Inspector in Chennai) or a labour inspector
Not a member of any other welfare board
Resident of Tamil Nadu with a ration card; workers from other states register separately on the same portal
Registration and all claims are free; renew the registration on time or benefits stop
Work certificate in the board's format, signed by the employer, union, contractor or VAO
Age proof: driving licence, school certificate, voter ID or a doctor's certificate
Ration (smart family) card
Proof of relationship with the nominee
Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Boards portal
Your own number. Until the officer approves, you can log in only with the OTP sent here.
Ration card / smart card number
From your family smart card. Family members are taken from this card.
6-digit code from the SMS
Type it within the time shown, or press Resend OTP.
Welfare board
Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board
Choose the construction board, not the manual workers' board.
Nature of work
Pick the trade written on your work certificate.
Name and father's / husband's name
Arumugam S / Subramani
As in Aadhaar.
From the age proof you upload. You must be between 18 and 60.
Your own Aadhaar.
An account in your own name. Every benefit is paid into it.
Nominee and family members (name, relation, age)
Valli A, wife, 38; Divya A, daughter, 15
Enter every member with the correct age. Education and marriage help for children is decided by age.
Get the work certificate filled and signed in the board's format by your employer, union, contractor or VAO, and keep photos or scans of all documents ready.
Open the portal, click New Registration, enter your mobile number and ration card number and verify the OTP.
Choose the Construction Workers Welfare Board and your trade, fill in your personal, bank, nominee and family details, upload the documents and submit. The application number comes by SMS.
The Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) office checks it. If anything is missing you get an SMS: log in with OTP, correct it and submit again.
On approval, the permanent registration number and password come by SMS. Log in and download your registration certificate.
For each benefit, such as education help, marriage, maternity or the pension at 60, log in and file a Claim with the proof. The money is paid into your bank account.
Renew the registration on the portal before it expires so that your benefits continue.
No toll-free number: call or visit the Assistant Commissioner of Labour (Social Security Scheme) office in your district; complaints can also be filed under Grievance Form on the board's portal
Tamil Nadu Social Security Pension (Old Age, Widow and Disability Pension)
Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Social Security Scheme), Government of Tamil Nadu

A monthly pension from the Tamil Nadu government for poor elderly people, widows, deserted women, unmarried poor women over 50, landless farm workers over 60 and persons with disabilities. Most get Rs 1,200 a month, and persons with disabilities get Rs 1,500, paid into the bank account; the central old-age, widow and disability pensions are included in this amount. You apply online through e-Sevai, yourself or at an e-Sevai centre. The VAO and Revenue Inspector verify the application, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office sanctions it.
Rs 1,200 a month (Rs 1,500 for persons with disabilities)
Old age pension: aged 60 or above, destitute and from a below-poverty-line family
Widow pension: a destitute widow aged 18 or above
Disability pension: 40% disability or more, aged 18 or above, and unemployed or earning under Rs 3 lakh a year
Also for deserted women aged 30 or above, unmarried poor women aged 50 or above, and landless farm workers aged 60 or above (Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu scheme)
Immovable property worth no more than Rs 1,00,000, not counting a house given free by the government
Age proof, such as a birth certificate, school certificate or a doctor's age certificate
Bank passbook of an account in the applicant's own name
Husband's death certificate for a widow, or the disability certificate or UDID card for a person with disability
Your Common Account Number on e-Sevai. If you have none, create it free with your Aadhaar and mobile number first.
Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
Choose old age, widow, disability, deserted women, unmarried women or Uzhavar Pathukappu, whichever fits you.
Rajammal K
From the age proof you upload.
From the family smart card.
Monthly income and property value
No regular income; no land or house of her own
Write the truth. The VAO checks this, and property above Rs 1 lakh, apart from a free government house, makes you ineligible.
An account in the applicant's own name. The pension is paid here every month.
Address (village, taluk, district)
3, Mariamman Kovil Street, Keezhapudur, Paramakudi taluk, Ramanathapuram
Where you live now. The VAO of this village does the verification.
Documents to upload
Aadhaar, ration card, photo, age proof
Clear photos or scans. A widow adds the husband's death certificate; a person with disability adds the disability certificate.
Log in on the e-Sevai citizen portal with your CAN number, or go to any e-Sevai centre, where the operator applies for you.
Choose the Revenue Department social security pension service, pick the right scheme, fill in the details and upload the documents.
Submit and keep the application number from the receipt or SMS.
The VAO and the Revenue Inspector visit or call to check your age, income and property, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office decides.
Once sanctioned, the pension is paid into your bank account every month. You can check the status on e-Sevai with the application number.
If it is rejected or delayed, meet the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office, or complain on the 1100 helpline.
1100 — Tamil Nadu citizen helpline / Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at your taluk office
Rythu Bharosa (Rs.12,000 per Acre for Farmers)
Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Telangana

Telangana gives farmers Rs.12,000 per acre a year for crop costs, paid as Rs.6,000 per acre before each season (Vanakalam and Yasangi) straight into the farmer's bank account. Rythu Bharosa replaced the old Rythu Bandhu scheme from 26 January 2025. Every pattadar whose farmland is recorded in Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) is included automatically, with no new application each season. A new farmer, or one whose money is not coming, gives bank and passbook details to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of the cluster.
Rs.12,000 per acre a year (Rs.6,000 per acre each season)
Pattadar (land owner) whose farmland is recorded in the Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) land records
Tribal farmers holding forest-rights (ROFR) pattas are also eligible
Money is paid only for land fit for farming. House plots, layouts, real-estate ventures, mines, roads and land taken for projects are left out
A bank account in the farmer's own name, linked with Aadhaar
Tenant farmers are not covered. Landless farm labourers have a separate scheme (Indiramma Atmiya Bharosa)
Pattadar passbook (PPB), copy
Bank passbook front page with account number and IFSC
Aadhaar consent form, signed (the AEO gives it)
Mutation / Bhu Bharati record if the land was bought or inherited recently

Give the filled Rythu Bharosa Bank Details Collection Form to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of your cluster at the Rythu Vedika, or at the Mandal Agriculture Office. Attach copies of the pattadar passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook, and sign the Aadhaar consent form. The AEO checks the details, signs the form and uploads it on the Rythu Bharosa portal. AEO mobile numbers are under Contact Us on rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in.
Siddipet / Gajwel / Chinna Rampur
Where the land is, as printed in the pattadar passbook.
Farmer name
Gaddam Venkataiah
Exactly as in the pattadar passbook.
Father / husband name
Gaddam Mallaiah
As in the passbook.
The farmer's own Aadhaar. It must be the same one linked to the bank account.
PPB (pattadar passbook) number
The number on the front of your pattadar passbook.
The bank's SMS for each payment comes to this number.
Bank name
State Bank of India
The bank where you want the money.
Branch name
Gajwel
As printed in the bank passbook.
Check every digit against the passbook. A wrong digit is the most common reason money does not arrive.
11 letters and numbers printed in the passbook.
Make sure your land is correctly recorded in Bhu Bharati and you have the pattadar passbook. Mutation of bought or inherited land must be finished first.
Get the Bank Details Collection Form from the AEO, or download it. Fill in your name, Aadhaar, passbook number, mobile number and bank details, and sign it.
Give it to the AEO at your Rythu Vedika with copies of the passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The AEO checks and uploads it on the portal.
Before each season the government releases the money, usually to small holdings first and then to larger ones. Rs.6,000 per acre is credited to your account by DBT.
Check the bank SMS or your passbook. If neighbours were paid and you were not, ask the AEO to check your status on the portal. The usual reasons are an Aadhaar-bank mismatch or a closed account.
If the problem stays, complain to the Mandal Agriculture Officer, then to the District Agriculture Officer or the Collector's grievance cell.
Your cluster AEO and Mandal Agriculture Officer (numbers under Contact Us on rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in); Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551
Telangana Construction Workers Registration (BOCW Labour Card)
Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department

A construction worker registered with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board gets an identity card and the board's benefits: Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident, Rs.1 lakh on natural death, up to Rs.5 lakh for permanent disability, Rs.30,000 for the marriage of a woman worker or of up to two daughters, and Rs.30,000 for each of up to two deliveries. Masons, helpers, painters, carpenters, plumbers, electricians, brick-kiln and road workers and over 50 other trades can register. Fill Form XXVII and give it at the Assistant Labour Officer's office with a work certificate and the Rs.50 fee; membership then costs Rs.12 a year.
Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident; Rs.30,000 each for marriage and for delivery
Works as a mason, helper or coolie, painter, carpenter, plumber, electrician, bar bender or centering worker, or in tiles, road, brick-kiln, quarry or another listed construction trade
Works in Telangana; migrant workers from other states can also register
Keeps membership renewed (Rs.12 a year or Rs.60 for five years) to stay eligible for benefits
Filled Form XXVII with two passport-size photos
Ration card and voter ID (copies)
Age proof: school certificate or doctor's certificate
Certificate of 90 days' work from the Assistant Labour Officer, a construction workers' union, or a registered builder or establishment
Bank passbook (account number, bank and branch)

At the office of the Assistant Labour Officer (ALO) for your area, mandal or circle. In Hyderabad, go to the ALO office of your circle. Download Form XXVII from tbocwwb.telangana.gov.in (Downloads) or get it at the ALO office, and fill it in Telugu or English.
Get the 90-day work certificate. The ALO can check your work at the site, or your union or builder can certify it.
Hand in the form with photos and copies at the ALO office and pay Rs.50 + Rs.12 (or Rs.60 for five years). Keep the receipt.
After the ALO checks your details, you get a registration number and the construction worker's identity card. You can check it under Search Registered Workers on the board's site.
Renew every year, or every five years, by SBI challan and give the challan copy to the ALO. Benefits stop if your membership lapses.
